QUOTE: Note the `ssl_pthread_server` thread is gated on `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (line 30). Without it, the example does not build with threads.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library runs no threads by default, but it does not say the pthread example compiles to a stub main. It only says the example "does not build with threads", which is not the same claim.
